reason: Static harness review found that high-road cognitive_tick calls LeftBrain.think, but LeftBrain.think can return _rule_based_plan before its model call. Route alone therefore cannot distinguish model and rule plan sources.

amended_plan_source_policy.determination: For each case, compare the isolated LeftBrain model-call log immediately before and after cognitive_tick. Low-road with zero calls is rule_low_road; high-road with zero calls is rule_high_road; high-road with exactly one call is model_high_road. Any other combination aborts before RightBrain inference.
amended_plan_source_policy.analysis_role: plan_source remains a descriptive stratification variable, not a treatment and not a fixed-count gate.
amended_plan_source_policy.leftbrain_call_integrity: The sum of per-case model-call deltas must equal the recorded LeftBrain model-call count and the number of model_high_road cases.
